title: the commit-paths proof hands the artifact door LF on every box
intention: The artifact tool's commit-paths proof hands the door a canonical (LF) record on every box, so it measures the hook rather than aborting in its fixture on Windows.
traces_to: Law 3; Law 8 (a proof that aborts in its fixture measures nothing).
how: D1 _door_write pipes utf-8 bytes, not text. D2 a sibling AST tooth keeps text-mode input out of that file.

clauses.claim: test_a_commit_takes_only_the_paths_its_author_names.py is green on Windows, where it red at _world with the door's CRLF refusal
test_the_commit_proof_pipes_the_door_lf.py reds on the unfixed proof naming its text-mode input call, on any box, and is green on the fixed one

decisions.text: D1: _door_write calls subprocess.run with input=(json.dumps(doc, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8') and no text=True, decoding stderr itself; _run drops its unused stdin parameter.
D2: new proof test_the_commit_proof_pipes_the_door_lf.py: an ast walk of the commit-paths proof finds no Call passing input= with text=True.

out: cairn/tools/artifact/artifact.py (the door is right to refuse)

measured.what: the commit-paths proof on Windows at house HEAD
measured.saw: red in _world: door REFUSED, body not canonical, found CRLF
both proofs green; hollow (unfixed proof restored) reds the AST tooth naming line 57
